cover_letter_text:
Hello Ryan,
I am applying for the Civil Engineer role at Allen Price, advertised on SEEK. Your advert describes civil design for land development, including roads, landform and stormwater, alongside town planners and surveyors in your Wollongong, Kiama and Nowra offices.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, carried out site inspections and reviewed drawings. As field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks and prepared progress reports. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D applying Australian Standards, and designed around existing services.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Wollongong for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and White Card. Could we arrange a call?
Marc Masarate
